title: Caution Before the Seelie

sources.title: Scroll of Bestial Communion
markers: | description = {{very rare|Scroll of Bestial Communion}} is a single-use scroll which can be [[Transcribing scrolls|transcribed]] or used to cast [[Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva]].

sources.title: Sights of the Seelie: Summon Deva

summary: Read the book to obtain a single-use Deva scroll. Cast it directly or have a Wizard scribe it.

fields.Base value: 2000 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Read: Read the book to obtain the Scroll of Bestial Communion.
fields.Cast the scroll: Spend an Action and consume the single-use scroll to summon a Deva.
fields.Wizard transcription: A Wizard can scribe the scroll instead. The learned spell uses an Action and a level 6 spell slot, recharges on a Short Rest, and summons a Deva until Long Rest.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
